El cerebro de cada robot es una red pequ: Each robot's brain is a small network of
en la capa oculta y en la salida. Una e: in the hidden and output layers. An input is simply a number describing the robot's state in that frame; the network receives no images. Its thirteen inputs summarize the position and distance of its target coin, its velocity, the distance to all four walls, the nearest cup, and its remaining caffeine. These values reach sixteen neurons, and each connection has a weight adjusted during training. Only two numbers come out: horizontal and vertical acceleration. There are 258 parameters in total, so evaluating it four times per frame costs very little. Even the trained weights fit in about 7 KB and travel as numbers inside an ES module, with no separate model file to load.
Evolution Strategies cabe en una frase:: Evolution Strategies fits in one sentence: each generation, I test random variations of the weights, score each one, and move the original weights toward the better-performing versions. What I liked was how little it takes to implement.

Entrenamiento y deploy forman un solo co: Training and deployment form one contract
La política no se entrena durante el dep: The policy isn't trained during deployment. It's trained offline and its weights are versioned as code. From there, CI treats the file like any other production artifact: checking its shape, values, and performance before building the image.
El gate evalúa 100 seeds no vistas, exig: The gate evaluates 100 unseen seeds, requires at least 300 generations, validates each checkpoint's 258 weights, and tests the policy at 20, 60, and 120 FPS.
GitHub Actions autentica con Azure media: GitHub Actions authenticates with Azure through OIDC, without static credentials, and builds the Web Docker image on the runner.
La imagen se publica en Azure Container: The image is published to Azure Container Registry with the commit SHA; EF Core migrations then run using a secret read from Key Vault.
Azure Container Apps actualiza el Web co: Azure Container Apps updates the Web with one to two replicas and waits up to 150 seconds for health and the hero's visual contract.
Si falla, el workflow restaura la imagen: If it fails, the workflow restores the previous image. The
